newsitem.title: CHILE: Codelco names Marcos Lima as chief executive.
newsitem.headline: Codelco names Marcos Lima as chief executive.

text.p: State copper company Codelco named its Vice President for Finance and Administration Marcos Lima as its new executive president, the government said.
"This is a sign of continuity in policy at Codelco," said Mining Minister Benjamin Teplizky, in announcing Lima's appointment after a Codelco board meeting.
Lima will replace Juan Villarzu, who took office Saturday as President Eduardo Frei's new chief-of-staff.
